evidence: From Lake Matheson car park, it’s a short walk to the beginning of the track and the suspension bridge over Clearwater Stream.
From Jetty Lookout, walk for 15 min through forest to View of Views Lookout at the top end of the lake.
From Reflection Island, it’s 35 min to the car park via the wetland at the eastern end of the lake.

doubts: Direction: the page says most people walk the circuit clockwise and that either direction is fine, but does not say the description is clockwise, so direction is null. View of Views Lookout is treated as a side trip because the text calls it a signposted side track with steps; its exact position in the order of the circuit is only roughly stated. Reflection Island is treated as on the way (steps down to a viewing platform, and the circuit returns to the car park from it). The timing text is slightly inconsistent ('another 5 min from Jetty Lookout to Reflection Island' after describing View of Views Lookout).
